text: dsh-tick-rail 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的会话导航插件。它通过客户端模块在 shell.overlay 界面层加入一列消息刻度，每格对应用户提问或补充指令，跳过助手回复。鼠标悬停时，当前刻度突出并显示消息片段；点击刻度可平滑跳转到对应消息，也可用方向键选择并按回车或空格跳转。它还会在消息较少时隐藏导航，并随窗口和对话变化重新测量。适合需要快速定位长对话中自己提问的 DSH 用户；无需额外 API key 或外部服务配置。

dsh-tick-rail adds a tick rail to the DeepSeek Harness web client, with one mark for each user prompt or steering note. Hover to preview a message, then click its tick or use the keyboard to jump to it. The rail hides in short conversations and needs no API key or external service.
想快速跳回长对话里之前发过的问题。
给 DSH 会话加一条能按消息定位的导航刻度。
我想扫一眼自己在对话里问过哪些内容。
能不能悬停在导航上先看消息片段再决定跳转？
用键盘在自己的提问之间移动并跳到选中的那条。
DSH 对话太长了，怎样快速回到某条用户消息？
Help me jump to an earlier question in a long DSH conversation.
Show a navigable index of my messages beside the conversation.
Preview a prompt before scrolling back to it.
Let me navigate between my conversation messages with the keyboard.
dsh-tick-rail 的功能「tick-index」：为会话中的用户提问和补充指令显示对应刻度，助手回复不单独占格；不足三条用户消息时隐藏导航。
dsh-tick-rail 的功能「hover-preview」：鼠标移到刻度上会突出当前位置，并显示对应用户消息的文本片段，便于跳转前辨认内容。
dsh-tick-rail 的功能「jump-to-message」：点击刻度会将会话滚动到对应消息；插件使用动画滚动，并在减少动态效果或动画无法推进时直接定位。
dsh-tick-rail 的功能「keyboard-navigation」：导航条可聚焦，方向键移动选中刻度，Enter 或空格跳转，Escape 或失焦收起预览。

dsh-tick-rail README · dsh-tick-rail：A tick-rail conversation navigator for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web UI.

为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供的会话刻度线导航条。

dsh-tick-rail README · What it does · 功能：A slim rail of tick marks appears beside the conversation — one tick per message you sent (your prompts and steering notes; assistant replies are skipped), so the rail reads as an index of your questions.

dsh-tick-rail README · What it does · 功能：- **Peak-falloff highlight** — the lit tick is the longest and the surrounding ticks taper off evenly, forming a peak that follows your mouse as it moves along the rail. When the mouse leaves, the rail returns to its resting profile: an alternating long-short rhythm of ticks.
- **Hover preview** — a floating card next to the rail shows a snippet of the message under the peak.
- **Click to jump** — click anywhere on the rail to smooth-scroll the conversation to that message.
- **Keyboard friendly** — the rail is focusable: arrow keys move the peak, Enter or Space jumps, Escape dismisses the preview.
- The rail hides itself in short conversations (fewer than 3 of your messages) and renders nothing when no conversation is open.

dsh-tick-rail README · What it does · 功能：在会话旁边显示一列细小的刻度线——你发的每条消息一格(提问和补充指令;助手回复不占刻度),整条导航就是你的提问索引。

- **峰值衰减高亮**:点亮位置的刻度最长,两侧刻度均匀递减,形成一座跟随鼠标移动的"山峰";鼠标移开后恢复静止形态——长短交替、富有节奏感的刻度列。
- **悬停预览**:刻度旁弹出浮层卡片,显示峰顶对应消息的摘要。
- **点击跳转**:点击刻度区任意位置,会话平滑滚动到对应消息。
- **键盘可用**:导航条可聚焦,方向键移动峰值,Enter/空格跳转,Esc 收起预览。
- 你的消息少于 3 条时自动隐藏;没有打开会话时不渲染任何内容。

dsh-tick-rail README · Install · 安装：Download the `.tgz` from the [latest release](https://github.com/caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail/releases/latest), then:

从 [最新 Release](https://github.com/caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail/releases/latest) 下载 `.tgz`,然后:

```sh
dsh plugin add ./dsh-tick-rail-<version>.tgz
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Works in the browser UI and inside DSH Desktop.

安装后重启 `dsh web` 生效,浏览器界面和 DSH Desktop 内均可使用。

If the install stops with an `allowBuilds` error, add the exact key pnpm printed to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` in your profile directory, then re-run the command.

dsh-tick-rail README · Install · 安装：`dsh plugin add github:caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail` 也可以用,但 pnpm 会对一切 git 来源的依赖要求构建授权(即使本包并无构建步骤)。如果安装因 `allowBuilds` 报错中断,把 pnpm 输出中给出的键加进 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`,再重跑一次即可。

</details>

dsh-tick-rail README · How it works · 实现说明：Pure web-client plugin — the host half is empty. The client module mounts into the official `shell.overlay` slot, anchors ticks to the conversation's stable `data-chat-flow-*` DOM markers, and follows theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), so light and dark modes both work with no configuration.

纯 Web 客户端插件,host 侧为空实现。客户端模块挂载在官方 `shell.overlay` 插槽,通过会话 DOM 的稳定 `data-chat-flow-*` 标记定位消息,样式全部使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量,亮暗色模式开箱即用。
